correctness.rationale: The 24 selected lines form the published (24_4,32_3) incidence with 32 triple points, hence 96 intersecting pairs. On smooth complex quartic K3, a line is a (-2)-curve. The incidence matrix M has row sum 6, and E=sum x_i L_i is equivalent to 3H iff Mx=3*1: the converse combines total degree 12, square 36 and equality in Hodge index, with numerical=linear equivalence on a K3. An independently assembled M from actual listed triples has rank 16 and det(B)=-1728 for the stated 16-index principal minor, and exact rational solving of all 2^8 remaining binary assignments gave 64 twelve-line solutions, 32 complementary pairs. Independent Smith form gives (1^10,2^4,6,18); the coordinates of 3H and all other lines in the selected basis are integral whereas those of H have denominator 3, yielding index 3 and discriminant 192. No four-clique in the 24-line intersection graph prohibits any plane four-line factor, proving irreducibility of the unique cubic lift of each reduced section. The source checker contains all 24 line parameters and their quartic and concurrence checks; independent numerical lattice tests corroborate them but do not replace the underlying exact algebraic geometry and external 24-line input.
